_comment: POI badge glyphs, pulled at build time from the glyph sets listed in sprites/PROVENANCE.md by bin/poi-badges. Keys inside `icons` are sprite names the style references as freenauticalchart:<key>; values are <iconify-set>:<icon>, or null for a bare disc. Groups carry the disc colour: colour says which question the badge answers, the glyph says which facility. Add a category to a group here rather than drawing one.

berthing._comment: Do I stop here? Chart magenta, per S-4 B-142.2(5) — SMCFAC02 is drawn in CHMGD and the marina is SMCFAC02. This is INT 1's F10-F11.3 family entire: fishing harbour, marina, yacht berths, yacht club.

consumables._comment: Can I take something on or get rid of it?

haul-out._comment: Can I get the boat between land and water? Everything that puts a hull ashore, and the yard and rack it ends up in.

ashore._comment: Everything else, once tied up. CHGRD chart grey, which already means linework that recedes — these must not out-shout a navaid.
